candidats.titre: File:Dewey Ave Rt-66 at Park St Sapulpa OK 2026-09-15 10-46-45.jpg
candidats.description: Dewey Ave, Route 66 at Park St. The road was re-done for the Centenial of Rt-66 this year. On the left is the Odd Fellows Building. The corner is a rounded turret where you can see I.O.O.F. in the brick near the roof. It was built in 1908 and is a three-story red brick building. The two-story gold brick building on the right side of the street is the Kress Building. You can see the ghost name "Kress" in the center facing the street as well as on the front facing the side street. A metal panel runs above the two first-floor storefronts. At the top is a stepped parapet with stone coping. 126 Eas

At the top is a stepped parapet with stone coping. 121 East Dewey Avenue, Sapulpa, Oklahoma 74066. To it's left is the three story brick Stonewall / Theo. Berryhill building, built around 1910.
